entries.title: Psalms 21:1
segments: ¶<<To the chief Musician. A Psalm of David.>> The king shall joy in thy strength, Jehovah; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 21:2
segments: Thou hast given him his heart's desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 21:3
segments: For thou hast met him with the blessings of goodness; thou hast set a crown of pure gold on his head.

entries.title: Psalms 21:4
segments: He asked life of thee; thou gavest [it] him, length of days for ever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 21:5
segments: His glory is great through thy salvation; majesty and splendour hast thou laid upon him.

entries.title: Psalms 21:6
segments: For thou hast made him to be blessings for ever; thou hast filled him with joy by thy countenance.

entries.title: Psalms 21:7
segments: ¶For the king confideth in Jehovah: and through the loving-kindness of the Most High he shall not be moved.

entries.title: Psalms 21:8
segments: Thy hand shall find out all thine enemies; thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

entries.title: Psalms 21:9
segments: Thou shalt make them as a fiery furnace in the time of thy presence; Jehovah shall swallow them up in his anger, and the fire shall devour them:

entries.title: Psalms 21:10
segments: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

entries.title: Psalms 21:11
segments: For they intended evil against thee; they imagined a mischievous device, which they could not execute.

entries.title: Psalms 21:12
segments: For thou wilt make them turn their back; thou wilt make ready thy bowstring against their face.

entries.title: Psalms 21:13
segments: Be thou exalted, Jehovah, in thine own strength: we will sing and celebrate thy power.
